book.name: Iba
book.title: Iba ngwi a kye tso iJɔn

content: Nɛ ani di ongyesɔ oka odatu kyɛ esho le ba esɛ. A tukwun yi akpa, mmbwo di lowa nyan ikye mi esho; inɛ mgban kwɔ dafi onɔ mani, afɔ mgban di dzɛ dafi otlɛsɛ ola.
O kye ongwaafɛ ofulu-fulu nlasisa byabɔ. O kye afɔ mgban abugye tuokɛ mi onekyoo yi afɔ mgban abubɛ mi esɛ,
man o si feela okwukwo dafi agwudu otsɛɛtsɛ mgbi ugaba mani. Onɔ ngwi o feela mata, ela mgbi akpala egyafa ntona sandu.
Ngwi akpala egyafa sandu nɛ, ani wewo okyi lɔlu; nghaduu ani fwo ela mi esho gbɛɛ, <<Kye odzɛ ngwi akpala egyafa ntona gbɔ na da dika kye lɔlu wokɛ esɛ ba.>>
Nɛ ongyesɔ ongwu ani teyi din kye afɔ kwudzɛ onekyoo yi esɛ na, kyile abugye mgban lu esho.
Man o fa mbi ongwu ndzɛ oshishe nghataa gyegwu nani, ongwu nta esho yi esɛ yi onekyoo bɛyi ungwɔ ama nto mboma duu, di gbɛɛ, <<Onɔ ombeembe ka dzɛma wuba!
Nghaduu mi egbe ngwi ongyesɔ ongwu gyafa ka wewo ofo agba mgban ma, ungwɔ odaada mgbi Imgbasho ka mbwumbwo, yɛyɛ dafi o teyi noola nya engbidɔ mgban ama ogbɛɛsɛ mani.>>
Nɛ ela ngwi ani teyi fwo mi esho na diyɛ gbɔdzɛ yi ani kpɔɔ gbɛɛ: <<Lu, ka kyi gbɛlu afɛ ofulu-fulu nlasisa mi abɔ ongyesɔ nkwudzɛ mi onekyoo bɛyi esɛ nani.>>
Nghanɛ ani kɛ mbi ongyesɔ na ka nyan gbɛɛ non kye ongwaafɛ ofulu-fulu na nu ani. O nya ani gbɛɛ, <<Gbɛ di kye gye. Ka nu ifu mgbi abu maama, kpaa ka fyumfya mi ondu mgbi abu dafi enewo mani.>>
Ani kye gbɛlu afɛ ofulu-fulu ongbungbɛ mi abɔ ongyesɔ na kye gye. I fyumfya mi ondu mgbi ani dafi enewo mani, kpaa ngwi ani kye gye mbe nɛ, ifu mgbi ani yɛ maama.
Ta a nya ani gbɛɛ, <<Abu ka yegbɔ kyɛmɛ mi ikye inggisɛ ibyibyi, emi ɛsɛ yi ondudzɛ bɛyi emi utɔ.>>
